packages.name: expected-lite
packages.comment: role: mandatory; phases: build,consumer-build; exposure: public-api; delivery: fetched; selected-by: always; used-for: nonstd::expected behind jinja2::Result<T> in every Load/Render signature (include/jinja2cpp/template.h, template_env.h); make_unexpected in parsers and bindings; why: C++17 has no std::expected; the 2.0 API returns Result<T> (docs/api-2.0.md decision 4), and Clang 18 + libstdc++ at C++23 ships <expected> without std::expected; lighten: Keep until a C++23 floor. Header-only and small; could be vendored into include/ so consumers need nothing extra, at the cost of an ODR clash with a consumer's own expected-lite of another version; conan: expected-lite/0.9.0; conan-why: ConanCenter has expected-lite 0.9.0 at most (checked 2026-10-24); conan-build stays one version behind until 0.10.0 is published there

packages.name: fmt
packages.supplier: Organization: Victor Zverovich and fmt contributors
packages.comment: role: mandatory; phases: build,consumer-link; exposure: link; delivery: fetched; selected-by: always; used-for: Python str.format / format filter and %-formatting (src/python_format.cpp, serialize_filters.cpp, value_methods.cpp), number-to-string, wide-string formatting (fmt/xchar.h), error messages (error_info.cpp), the string builder's memory_buffer; why: Python's format-spec mini-language with runtime format strings, precision-as-argument and wchar_t output; std::format is C++20 and the floor is C++17; lighten: Keep. Could be built header-only (FMT_HEADER_ONLY) to remove the link-time dependency of static consumers, at a compile-time cost; replace with std::format only at a C++20 floor (wide output and runtime specs still need checking); conan: fmt/12.2.0

packages.name: boost
packages.comment: role: alternative; phases: test; exposure: public-optional; delivery: fetched; selected-by: JINJA2CPP_WITH_JSON_BINDINGS=boost with JINJA2CPP_BUILD_TESTS: internal mode fetches the release for the Boost.JSON adapter test and never installs it; external, external-boost and conan-build find a system Boost >= 1.75 (Conan: header-only) only when a Boost piece is selected; also-roles: test; used-for: The opt-in adapters only: Boost.JSON for the binding test, and Multiprecision with Config (boost-multiprecision, boost-config, fetched on their own) for the bigint=boost backend and the adapter test. The library links no Boost and the installed package never names it (0230 D7a); why: The adapter headers jinja2cpp/binding/boost_json.h and jinja2cpp/big_int/boost_cpp_int.h are public opt-in API, so CI keeps testing them; lighten: Done (docs/tasks/0230): span, small_vector, intrusive_ptr, unique_any, iterator_facade, the string algorithms, endian, filesystem and Boost.JSON metadata parsing have own replacements; scripts/sbom.py --check keeps <boost/ out of every other file; conan: boost/1.91.0; conan-why: ConanCenter has Boost 1.91.0 at most (checked 2026-10-24); conanfile.txt takes it header_only, and Boost is only an optional adapter dependency and test-only (0230); transitive-libraries: assert,compat,config,container,container_hash,core,describe,endian,headers,intrusive,json,move,mp11,predef,system,throw_exception,variant2,winapi
